Not verified yetCompare the safety number by voice to rule out anyone in the middle.

Compare it with the other person by voice or in person. If it matches, nobody is in the middle. It stays the same across reconnects, because the returning browser has to prove it's the same one.

Privacy

Both levels are end-to-end encrypted with post-quantum protection.

On a direct connection you and the other person can see each other's IP address.

Customize

Your own relay server (TURN)

Strict networks (VPNs, symmetric NAT, some offices and carriers) can't connect browsers directly and need a relay. The relay only ever sees encrypted data. One of the two people having a relay is usually enough.

Network check

See whether your network allows direct connections and whether a relay is reachable.
